description: Plans one student subscribed to, with status (past_due = late payment), current_period_end (the renewal day) and auto_renew. For "is he up to date / when does it renew?": list_students(search) gives the id, this gives the plan, list_subscription_payments the charges, and get_student(student_id) the payments_url to open them in the app. Read only: nothing is charged or renewed.
name: list_student_subscriptions
title: See a student subscriptions
